horoscopes.horoscope: You will be torn between work and family as both try to grab your attention. You may reserve the evening for having fun. You crave to become famous and are likely to accomplish your ambition shortly. You have Ganesha’s blessings to support you. Luck is unfortunately not with you on the personal front. Therefore, you need to keep your anger under control in order to maintain peace with your beloved, suggests Ganesha. Music will help you stay cool and relax. It’s time to share your thoughts with your partner. Ganesha says that today your health will remain good. Your suggestions might help others and that will make you happy. Today you will be able to complete many of your tasks as you will be in good mood and health. Today is going to be an auspicious day on the financial front for you. If you are so inclined, you can make piles of money. The day favours launching big projects. Luck is on your side today, foresees Ganesha. You may be handed over new assignments today. You are likely to share your opinions in the meeting. You may make a new progress on the career front. Your suggestions will be welcomed.

Ganesha is pleased to see that you have a bright day ahead. Your efforts are due to give the results you expect. If you are in a mood to achieve something more than usual, this is the day for it. You are not likely to be disappointed. You will be getting increasingly popular socially as well as professionally, and gaining the trust and support of one and all. Everyone will speak and think highly of your commitment and competence. You have to handle relationship carefully as you may experience differences with your partner and it might lead to disagreement, feels Ganesha. You have to compromise on the relationship front. It’s time to ward off the issues before things will turn complex, reminds Ganesha. You might remain stressful today, predicts Ganesha. Healthwise also the day is not in your favour. You might not be able to complete the tasks on hand. You may feel tired easily. It seems that the day is not in your favour. Ganesha feels that today is not too favourable for you on the financial front. You may face serious troubles. You will realise that if it was not for the support from others, you might have been broke. Today you will be in a mood to avoid difficult tasks and start the day with easy projects. You may have to stick to your responsibilities as you can’t sideline serious matters just because you are not in the mood. You should be sincere in all matters to avoid issues.

An auspicious day awaits you. You will pay more attention to your family than to your career or at the work-front. This will mean the resolution of some long pending issues and projects at home. An enjoyable time with your family and children awaits you, says Ganesha. On the personal front, you may have to handle issues related to loyalty with utmost care, cautions Ganesha. Ensuring a long-term relationship will be your priority. Things will remain good since you will trust your partner and give him/her the freedom he/she deserves. Ganesha says that today you might play a role of a ‘philosopher’ as you might solve the problems of the other people and guide them on the right track. You might feel tired and worked up. Today you are likely to be in a mood to flaunt your financial prowess, and towards that end will get yourself an image makeover. You may want to impress others by spending money like water. Maintaining quality will be in your mind today in the workplace. Ganesha feels you should not keep high expectations from people since you may have a chance to get disappointed, warns Ganesha. You may have to encourage your teammates to ensure a smooth productivity, says Ganesha.

The Archer will be quite sharp at work and equally penetrating in matters of the heart. Though you may temporarily lose focus, your mind will bring you back to the real world. You will work at break-neck speed only to be able to spend as much time as possible with your sweetheart. You may have to be patient about matters related to your personal life as a few things happen only in due time, says Ganesha. You should not be disappointed as the smooth relationship is not happening. You will surely enjoy when the good time will come to you. It seems that it is not that good day for you from the health point of view. The planetary transits are hard for you today. Ganesha feels that your resistance against odds will be very low. Cough and cold might catch you today. Ganesha feels that today you shall focus on your equations with your colleagues who can show you schemes to make money. If you need ready funds, loans will be sanctioned if you apply for them. You will experience a hectic day where you may have to extend the work hours. You will go the extra mile to get desired dividends. Be positive and remain calm under any difficult situation. This will definitely help you face all the challenges you come across, says Ganesha.

Pack your bags, and don’t forget the sunscreen and the shades. Look at the stars today — Ganesha foresees for you a strong prospect of going on a tour. If not an individual backpacking adventure, then an elaborate family holiday, but travel you shall. With Lady Luck smiling upon you all day long, getting work done to the satisfaction of all is not an issue. So wrap up the workload, and grab your suitcase. Bon voyage!. Today you may play the role of a love guru where you would like to ignite passion in your mate differently. You won’t be bossy but Ganesha feels you are likely to nurture your loved one and express your love in a creative manner and the results will be encouraging. You may feel very energetic today. Your mood also will be very good. No complications regarding health are foreseen. You should do exercise to remain healthy. Ganesha advises you to remain positive for a healthy mind. On the monetary front, today is an auspicious day for you, foresees Ganesha. You shall reap some good money from your hard work, and some friends will show you some lucrative projects. Your enthusiasm will keep you strong today. Your peaceful mind will help you come up with new ideas and insights on the career front. Success is at your doorstep. All you need to do is to seize the opportunities at the right time, suggests Ganesha.

Today, find yourself rummaging through the vast recesses of your inner self. You will make fabulous money to spend on your loved ones. Face up to work pressures by indulging in corporeal pleasures. You may warrant the company of someone special to think out loud all that is inside you, says Ganesha. Peace of mind is highlighted for the day. Fortunately, you will have a wonderful time with your spouse and you will be in seventh heaven throughout the evening. Chatting and sharing a lot of insights related to your personal relationship will broaden your horizon, feels Ganesha. Today you might feel like a lazy bum. You are suggested to take necessary rest. The day is not in favour for the tasks which require more energy. Listening to music may make you feel good. If you wish to buy some luxurious things to make life more comfortable for your family, such as large screen TVs, some good furniture, then the stars are in favour. These things will prove to be a source of joy. Balancing the professional and domestic demands can be a little challenging, feels Ganesha. You need to set your priorities first and you will easily get rid of this confusion. Things will fall in the right direction once you share your ideas with people and measure the necessary impacts.

Ganesha says that you need to be more careful in your work field as your enemies or your competitors will try to pull you down today. You will have to be very careful in making business agreements or negotiations regarding give and take in the business. You will see your beloved grow distant from you today. Personal life seems to be steady, foresees Ganesha. If your partner has not had a good day, ensure that you don’t be angry. You should not let the disagreement come to your mind. The best you can do is to help your partner calm down, suggests Ganesha. According to Ganesha, you will be in good health. Enthusiasm will flow the whole day. You will be willing to gossip with others. On the whole, you will remain enthusiastic the entire day. Ganesha says that today will be rather an uneventful day on the financial front for you. Things will neither go the negative way nor the positive way, and you will neither gain much nor lose much. It’s an auspicious day for internal meetings, says Ganesha. You will be brief and to the point and expect the same from your colleagues. You will pay attention to everyone’s suggestion and then may come up with the decision. You will guide everyone in their routine work.

You shall also work like a donkey and yet be smart as hell in what you do today. It is favourable if you engage in household activities – gardening, cooking, cleaning and the likes. Work pressure will be displaced by family pleasure, predicts Ganesha. In personal life, you will eventually get yourself out of criticism or you may end up into a fight with your sweetheart. You should not be aggressive. You will be able to maintain a sweet relationship once you can handle your relationship carefully. You should not waste your energy behind arguing with others, suggests Ganesha. Do not let fights take out the major chunk of your energy. Though the day is not indicating bad health but you should remain cautious. Ganesha predicts that with the support of family members and their inspiration you shall find ways to boost in your regular income. If you remain united with your family, you will grow rich faster. Today your success depends on the way you deal with people in and outside the office. Try to be as polite as possible and try to get the work done in ways without being demanding. Diplomacy is the key to sustaining your professional achievement.

Your ways to deal with your team mates and colleagues will be strict and disciplined. However, your perfect ways at work will leave them awestruck. Your personal equations will be least affected by your stern ways, says Ganesha. Do not let success go to your head. A wise and intellectual conversations with your sweetheart may turn your relationship positive, feels Ganesha. You are likely to be strongly influenced by your partner when you come across a new thing or subject. You will enjoy a smooth relationship, says Ganesha. The day will engage lot many activities. You will deal with things wonderfully because your health and energy levels will be high. Your sportsman-spirit today will make you win many hearts. The day is going to pass very peacefully, says Ganesha. If you are able to gain self-control, you will remain happier financially. If you lose control over impulses, you may end up spending good sum and may not have much left in your account. Your energy will be the source of inspiration today. Therefore, you will never mind the pressure at the office. This is a good opportunity to concentrate on your priorities and sharpen your intellect, says Ganesha. Time to invest your energy in reading something inspirational or creative stuff.

Impulsiveness, which is not really your trait, will be very evident in whatever work you do today, say Ganesha. Money matters will keep you preoccupied for major part of the day, but ironically, your otherwise methodical approach to everything will go for a toss. You will splurge in the second half of the day, and it will be more than what your means can afford. Keep a check on the sudden flow of spontaneity in your actions, or you may later regret taking certain decisions. Intense love is on the cards, says Ganesha. Time will get romantic when you sit down with your partner and pay attention to his/her pain points. You may expect novelty from your loved one. The passionate relationship will keep your relationship harmonious. You will not be in a position to complete all your tasks which will generate stress. You can try Yoga or meditation today but avoid physically and mentally challenging tasks. Avoid over-thinking and socialize more to avoid getting negative, says Ganesha. There will be strong urge to please a person of opposite sex, for which, you may not see your pocket. As long as it is giving you joy, you should be spending the amount but ensure that you stick to your budget. You may not wish to waste time on worthless pursuits but you may be forced to deal with a few mundane activities at work. Besides, you might also have to get some petty problems solved. However, your hard work will be valued and you will be benefited in a few days.

You are ambitious, and quite unapologetic about the way you pursue your goals! You will work hard and push your way through if you have to. Not just that, you will see to it that you have all the skills and competency required to make it big. Success is never served on a plate, and you know it, says Ganesha. Your independence will keep you detached from your sweetheart. To be on the safer side, handle your partner’s emotions with maximum care. Your relationship will be good when you present a fantastic gift to the person you love the most, feels Ganesha. The day is good from health point of view. It’s about sharing with your friends. You should catch up with your friends and give them surprise. You will be in cheerful mood so there is nothing else to be worried about. Ganesha feels that today, your time and energy will be invested more in thinking rather than action. This will not help generate money but will open doors to many dimensions that you should be aware of. Important meetings and planning should do well today. You may be loaded with some new responsibilities today. You should not refrain yourself from taking them up as it will benefit your career progress, advises Ganesha. Meetings will keep you busy even though you will feel free to express your views.

Well begun is half done. With this in mind, you will set out to actively seek the cooperation of your colleagues and the sanction of your seniors to tackle some important projects, says Ganesha. The evening should find you heading out to watch a movie or doing something creative, like painting. You are likely to find peace and solace. You may remain unhappy unless you sit beside your sweetheart after the busy hours and share some sweet words. Ganesha finds you enjoying your evening with your beloved at a place that is close to your heart. The day is good for your mood and energy levels. Your energy levels will be on the rise. This will help you fcous well on your professional targets. You will work for longer hours and won’t get tired due to the same. Ganesha advise you to take this day very seriously and you must invest time, energy and money only behind activities that seem productive. Today, you shouldn’t waste time as ‘time is money’. Ganesha finds you in a career-oriented mood today. Activities that eat up too much time, will not be on your agenda today. You may be in a mood to work on basics of all issues as you seem to be in a bit of hurry to wind up work today.
